status.evidence: According to an official Simpro Group press release, the company acquired Leeds-based job management software provider BigChange on 25 October 2024.

claims.claim: A client case study involving D-tox demonstrated the deployment of BigChange's 5-in-1 system incorporating mobile apps on rugged tablets live-connected to back-office software alongside hard-wired or plug-and-go vehicle tracking connected via OBD-II ports.
claims.note: hard-wired or plug-and-go vehicle tracking connected via OBD-II ports

claims.claim: The company reports that its Route Optimiser feature dynamically integrates with the Google Maps API to evaluate traffic and road network status in real time, and its customers achieve an average of 11% less drive time and 10% lower fuel consumption.
claims.note: average of 11% less drive time and 10% lower fuel consumption

claims.claim: The company reports providing a choice between hard-wired tracking installations or plug-and-go units connecting directly to a vehicle's OBD-II port, as well as optional HGV CANbus and tachograph integration via a Squarell 'Flex' device and contactless CANcliQ pickup, according to the BigChange Official Website and BigChange Help Guide.

The company reports that its AssetWatch trailer tracking solution utilizes rugged, waterproof tracking hardware (minimum IP66 rating) equipped with an autonomous internal rechargeable battery, motion-based wake-up functionality, and daily location updates, according to the BigChange Help Guide.
claims.note: autonomous internal rechargeable battery, motion-based wake-up functionality, and daily location updates
claims.source: BigChange Help Guide (AssetWatch: BigChange's Trailer Tracking Solution)

claims.claim: BigChange Limited operates an Integrated Management System independently certified to ISO 27001 (Information Security Management), ISO 9001 (Quality Management), Cyber Essentials, and SOC 2 Type 1 standards, as outlined in the BigChange Compliance Portal.

The company integrates automated data retention, "Right to be Forgotten" anonymisation of job cards, and Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) workflows directly within its CRM system to ensure adherence to UK GDPR, according to the BigChange Help Guide.
claims.source: BigChange Help Guide (Managing the Right to be Forgotten & FAQs articles)

claims.claim: Complete Business Solutions integrated BigChange's JobWatch mobile app directly with their internal Horizon ERP system to enable real-time electronic proof of delivery data sync across a fleet of 150 vehicles.
claims.source: BigChange Customer Success Story: Complete Business Solutions via FeaturedCustomers

claims.claim: Sunbelt Rentals deployed the BigChange platform across 161 depots, integrating it with their proprietary contract administration system (MCS) to handle over 100,000 jobs via the cloud-based office software.
claims.source: BigChange Success Stories: Sunbelt Rentals Transforms Business with BigChange Mobile Technology

claims.claim: A public case study published by BigChange details that global mining, energy, and logistics company Hargreaves Services Plc awarded a mobile technology contract to the company to supply its three-in-one JobWatch system across a 500-strong fleet of specialist aggregates vehicles.
claims.corrected: A public case study published by BigChange details that global mining, energy, and logistics company Hargreaves Services Plc awarded a mobile technology contract to the company to supply its three-in-one JobWatch system across a 500-strong fleet of specialist logistics vehicles.
claims.source: BigChange Press Release via Hub-4 & Agg-Net

claims.claim: A separate case study published by BigChange confirms that Sapphire Utility Solutions deployed the BigChange job management platform to support its multi-million-pound Severn Trent Water Network Operations Support Services contract, which services four million homes and businesses across the Midlands and mid-Wales.
claims.source: BigChange Success Stories: BigChange boosts Sapphire's productivity by 100% on multi-million-pound water contract

claims.claim: The company reported that its annual software recurring revenue surpassed £30 million, reflecting a 140% three-year growth rate.
BigChange Limited secured a £75 million private equity investment led by Great Hill Partners in 2021 to fund further expansion.

BigChange Limited established a strategic vehicle procurement and fleet review partnership with Synergy Leasing, enabling customers to secure volume discounts and leasing options across its aggregated 75,000-vehicle network.
The company launched a dedicated UK channel partner programme to drive regional distribution via independent resellers, appointing initial partners including PRS Telecom and Penmark Limited.
The company reports that its software architecture manages an active global ecosystem of over 75,000 vehicles, negotiating vehicle procurement discounts under the BigChange Fleet platform program.

The company reports that its operational tracking infrastructure supports 50,000 active tracking devices deployed across more than 1,700 customers, recording over 625 million miles driven through its systems in 2022, as disclosed via official BigChange training resources.
claims.note: The metrics '50,000 active tracking devices' (official sources specify 50,000 field-service workers and back-office personnel instead) and '625 million miles driven through its systems in 2022' are unconfirmed by public documentation.
claims.source: BigChange Developer Docs (About Us), Trustpilot Company Profile

claims.claim: The company reports providing 24/7 UK-based customer support via its dedicated RoadCrew department, managed alongside accounts from its primary headquarters facility located at 3175 Century Way, Thorpe Park, Leeds, LS15 8ZB.
claims.source: BigChange Official Site (Contact Us page & January 2024 Community Update)

claims.claim: Public corporate registers and organizational tracking records verify that BigChange Limited maintains its sole active UK registered office in Leeds, managing an operational headcount of between 200 and 224 employees as of its most recent reported tracking cycles.
claims.source: UK Companies House, GetLatka Database, Glassdoor Company Overview

status.evidence: UK Telematics Limited (HQ Wrexham) is actively operating and was acquired by Radius Payment Solutions on 4 October 2016 according to PitchBook and Companies House records.

UK Telematics.label: UK Telematics (subsidiary of Radius Payment Solutions)

claims.claim: The company reports a guaranteed platform uptime of 99.75% for its web-based vehicle tracking systems, as detailed on the UK Telematics About Page.

Lincolnshire Police approved the procurement of the UK Telematics fleet solution under the Yorkshire and Humberside Police Framework to manage fleet metrics including speed, driver behavior, and vehicle utilization, as detailed in an official Lincolnshire Police decision log.
claims.source: Lincolnshire Police PCC Request for Decision Ref 013/2019 (https://lincolnshire-pcc.gov.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/013-2019-vts.pdf)

claims.claim: A call-off contract awarded by Devon and Somerset Fire and Rescue Authority to UK Telematics under the Crown Commercial Service Framework RM6353 covers the ongoing provision and maintenance of journey and incident data recorders, front-facing vehicle cameras, and driver identification systems.
claims.source: UK Contracts Finder / Bidstats Award Notice (https://bidstats.uk/tenders/2026/W32/875823422)

claims.claim: The company reports that its operations utilize covertly fitted, CE-marked Vehicle Tracking Units (VTUs) that are approved by the VCA, tested by CETECOM, and deployed via a nationwide mobile network of FCS1362 and FITAS standard installation engineers.

The company reports that it holds an active ISO 9001 certification and supplies its fleet tracking services under the Crown Commercial Service frameworks RM6315 and RM6353, as detailed on the UK Telematics Official About Page.

The company reports providing integration with enterprise systems by partnering with Maple, Panasonic, and Ventyx to deliver real-time GPS feeds in NMEA format directly to in-cab Panasonic Toughbooks for its client, Wales and West Utilities.

The company reports that it is an official Garmin integration partner, continually developing on the latest Fleet Management Interface (FMI) protocols and Android devices to provide joined-up in-cab solutions.

UK Telematics was awarded a £620,000 call-off contract by the Devon and Somerset Fire and Rescue Authority under the Crown Commercial Service Framework RM6353 (Lot 4) for the ongoing provision, support, and maintenance of vehicle telematics hardware, software, journey and incident data recorders, and front-facing vehicle cameras.

The Office of the Police, Fire and Crime Commissioner for Northamptonshire executed a contract variation with UK Telematics for the supply and fit of vehicle telematics, increasing the total contract value from £362,346 to £389,976.30 ex VAT for a contract period running from 7th June 2021 to 6th June 2026.

UK Telematics Limited is registered at Companies House under company number 04203244 as a private limited company and qualifies under the small companies regime, meaning its annual turnover is under £15 million and its balance sheet total is under £7.5 million.
claims.corrected: UK Telematics Limited is registered at Companies House under company number 04203244 as a private limited company and qualifies under the small companies regime, meaning its annual turnover is under £10.2 million and its balance sheet total is under £5.1 million.

claims.claim: Radius Payment Solutions Limited (the parent corporation) filed consolidated financial reports with Companies House confirming that UK Telematics Limited is operated as a subsidiary within its global telematics division, which reported an overall gross profit increase of nearly 60% to £28.3 million across more than 20 countries.
claims.note: The overall gross profit increase of nearly 60% to £28.3 million across more than 20 countries is unconfirmed.
claims.source: Companies House filing history for UK Telematics Limited

claims.claim: A technical integration partnership with Maple, Panasonic, and Ventyx to supply real-time GPS feeds in NMEA format for Toughbooks used by Wales and West Utilities, alongside a formal development partnership with Garmin for FMI protocols.
claims.source: UK Telematics Official Website (Solution Flexibility Page)

claims.claim: Supply-side integration within UK government frameworks, specifically holding designated positions as a supplier on the Crown Commercial Service frameworks RM6315 and RM6353.
PitchBook reports that UK Telematics operates as an acquired operating subsidiary of Radius Payment Solutions, which acquired the Wrexham-based business on 4 October 2016.
claims.source: PitchBook Company Profile for UK Telematics

claims.claim: Public procurement data from D3 Tenders states that UK Telematics Limited was awarded a commercial vehicle contract (S1106) for a Fleet Tracking System signed on 2 October 2025.
claims.note: The specific platform 'D3 Tenders' and the contract reference number 'S1106' are unconfirmed.

claims.claim: UK Telematics official website specifies its official headquarters in Wrexham, United Kingdom, and highlights that it is part of Radius, a larger parent corporation that operates 55 global offices and employs more than 2,900 individuals.

UK Telematics official website reports a guaranteed software uptime agreement of 99.75% for its web-based global positioning platform and deploys a nationwide mobile installation team utilizing FCS1362/FITAS accredited engineers.
